notes.title: Patch v0.6.2 and v0.6.3
notes.notes:
A small patch in preparation for v0.7.0


[strike]Removed Full Jump Release - This option made Chipset v2 unbeatable, and was generally a bad idea. I was supposed to remove this months ago, but.. yeah, new engine things kept me too busy, I guess.[/strike]

Disabled Steam Achievements - v0.7.0 will have completely revamped achievements, less focused on deathless stuff, and more focused on... fun, perhaps.

Disabled Level Builder - v0.7.0 will have a completely different map structure. Everything is different, and thus, all current maps will be incompatible. Not just data-wise - gameplay-wise too, as physics are also getting a major change.


And all the things I've mentioned here are just scratching the surface of how large the next update is (yes, even a brand new engine is barely anything!).

Sorry for the silence for over half a year here on Steam, but the wait will be worth it. I hope.

I'll post some news when I get some things to show.

See you until then :)

hop on the discord server for some chatting if you want, I'm not inactive in the community, only the updates! :)

v0.6.3
Added Full Jump Release back (sorta). See "What does this mean?" in the game settings (in-game) for an explanation.

Hour 1 hotfixes, only from Daveyyy!

Fixes:

 Fixed an issue with stationary dash, which would prevent it from dashing in the correct direction in certain situations

notes.title: Update v0.6.0
notes.notes:
Steam Achievements are here!

I've decided to split the next major update into 2 parts so you don't have to wait for achievements and a few gameplay options, so here you go! c:

There are achievements for completing each map, and completing each map with 0 respawns, except for Extra Maps, which don't have deathless achievements, in case you haven't been following our recent voting and discussions.

Also, there are 2 new gameplay options:

 Stationary dash is back, as an optional setting that you can enable anytime you want. (You know, the thing that allowed you to dash while not moving, based on your last pressed direction)

 Full Jump Release option will remove all of your upwards velocity when you release a jump key, instead of cutting it by 3 like it normally is. This was requested by some experienced players in our community, although it's rather experimental. I personally don't recommend playing with it, but it's worth a try. Up to you :D


Next update will be the first major Micro Platformer update ever, so stay tuned for that ;)

notes.title: Update v0.4.0
notes.notes:
New stuff:

 You can now remap your keys! Pretty much every normal button is supported, tho it might not be fully readable yet as some buttons use indexes instead of their "names". To change your keybinds, go to Settings, then click the field with inputs of the action you want to remap. The field will turn yellow. Then, press the key you want to map. To add more keys, simply click the field again. Clear buttons will remove all inputs from an action, and Reset button will reset all actions to their default inputs.
 Input buffering! Ever felt like you pressed a key but the square didn't jump because it was 50ms from touching the ground? Fear no more, as input buffering is here! With a current maximum duration of 0.1s, you have quite a bunch of time to press the jump & dash key. Basically, as long as you press the key within that duration all the way until the action is possible again, the action will be executed as soon as possible. So, if you pressed jump up to 0.1s too early, the square will still jump as long as you are still holding the jump button when it touches the ground / wall / jump crystal. Same thing works for dash. This will definitely make the whole experience a lot smoother, especially while speedrunning.
 You can now press a key twice to quickly restart a map. (default: keyboard R / Xbox Y)
 Jumping on the ground while touching a wall will now preform a neutral jump instead of a wall jump. This neutral jump also refreshes your jump, so you can use it to double jump.
 When dashing from the ground, dash will keep neutral jump state if it hits a wall before it ends. This will allow you to preform previously mentioned neutral jump that allows you to double jump even if you aren't touching the ground.
 Starting a map will now have a 0.5s duration of idle time (the time where you can't move - respawn time). Timers will not progress during this period to ensure no speedruns are affected by this change.
 Removed stationary dash because it was a bit too confusing to use.
 Clearing save files will finally add cleared save time to total time.
 Changed custom levels folder structure. Built maps are now located in the WIP folder under the name "map_name (zip this folder when uploading)". As the name suggests, this is the fodler that you need to zip when uploading a map, or copy to the custom maps folder to load it.
 Changed how some buttons select. It's still faaaar from decent, but it should help for now.


Fixes:

 Fixed dash not keeping your upwards vertical velocity when hitting a wall.
 Fixed an issue that would crash the game when going outside of room bounds.
 Fixed a bug that would let you switch pages when there were only 5 custom levels, which would then hide the first level if you switched back.
 Fixed a bug that would cause total time to display 6 decimal spaces when total time was less tha 1 minute.
 Fixed a bug that would crash the game if you pressed "down" on the page button.


In other news, Micro Platformer is now on srcom!
https://www.speedrun.com/micro_platformer

notes.title: Hotfix v0.3.2
notes.notes: Fixed a serious issue with Clear buttons for custom maps, which would cause them to clear official map save files instead of the custom ones.

notes.title: Hotfix v0.3.1
notes.notes: Fixed a critical bug that would crash a custom map when swapping build levels.

notes.title: Update v0.3.0
notes.notes:
Custom Levels are here!

Yes, you heard that right, you can now create your own levels with your favorite pixel art program and the new Level Builder! Everything is detailed in the builder once you press "Help", so read that before you begin :D
And yes, stats like total respawns and best times are also supported on custom levels. Enjoy!

Other changes:

 Changed how timers are displayed - they are now much more accurate for best times, with up to 3 decimal spaces.


Next update will be about reworking the buttons. I feel you controller users, I know they are not the best. Just hang on for a little longer!

notes.title: Hotfix v0.2.2
notes.notes:
Fixed a very serious bug that would make beating room 18 of Chipset almost impossible on lower framerates
 Increased physics engine tick rate from ~120fps to ~480fps
 Modified room 18 of Chipset to make it much easier


If you were stuck at room 18 of Chipset, try again.
Sorry for messing up so hard :(

notes.title: Hotfix v0.2.1
notes.notes:
Fixes:

 Fixed a critical bug that would prevent dash from triggering after a queued jump

notes.title: Update v0.2.0
notes.notes:
New world, new difficulty!

 Chipset - a brand new world with another 25 levels, offering some great challenge even for experienced players.


Some other stuff:

 You can now dash while stationary - the direction will be determined by the last directional key you pressed
 Your jump will now queue if you are still respawning instead of being ignored, as long as you are holding the jump button for the rest of the respawn
 Added Xbox X / PS Square as an additional dash button
 Speedrun mode overlay is now more transparent


Fixes:

 Fixed a bug that would let you select Clear buttons even if all of them were invisible

notes.title: Update v0.1.0
notes.notes:
New stuff:

 You can now clear existing room saves whenever you want - just click the new "Clear" button twice!
 Speedrun mode! Enable this mode in the Level Select menu to enable an overlay that displays current total time of a run, current room, best total time on the room you're in, and the difference between your best and current time on each room!


Fixes:

 Fixed a bug where buttons in the Level Select menu were not selected in order when using a controller stick.
 Fixed a typo in the tutorial.
 End screen now says "Respawns" instead of "Deaths".


Another update with new levels should be up in a few days. Enjoy c:
